claim.claim: Microsoft's operating margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was above 40%.

verdict.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
verdict.reasoning_summary:
The claim asserts that Microsoft's operating margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was above 40%. This is a numeric claim requiring verification of the operating margin (operating income divided by revenue) for Q4 FY2026.

While the evidence includes multiple passages from Microsoft's 10-K filed on 2026-07-29 covering the period ending 2026-06-30, none of the provided evidence passages contain the actual operating margin figure or the underlying operating income and revenue figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Evidence E1 discusses share repurchases and dividends for Q4 FY2026 but contains no income statement data. Evidence E2 discusses internal controls. Evidence E3 discusses tax matters. Evidence E4 discusses share repurchase programs. Evidence E5 is from the Q3 10-Q (period ending March 31, 2026). Evidence E6 discusses segment performance for what appears to be a different period with percentage changes but does not provide the specific operating margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Without access to the actual income statement data showing operating income and revenue (or a direct statement of operating margin) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, I cannot verify whether the operating margin was above 40%.
